concerns.text: Task T011 bundles many distinct deliverables (regression, theoretical bound validation, sweet‑spot detection, multiple figures, methods summary, reproducibility log) into a single task, making it overly coarse. Split into separate tasks (e.g., T011‑a regression, T011‑b theoretical bound, T011‑c sweet‑spot, T011‑d figures, T011‑e methods summary, T011‑f reproducibility log) to improve granularity and enable independent verification.
